text:
Maya R: Heads up — onboarding for new org `acme-ml-prod` today. Need a cross-cloud provisioning + quota checklist. Priority: GPU quota increases (A100/H100), egress + VPC quotas, and IAM roles. Can someone run point?

Samir: I can drive GPU quota requests for AWS and GCP. Which regions?

Maya R: us-west-2 (primary), eu-west-1 (backup), ap-southeast-1 for dev. Also need soft-limit bump in us-west-2 to support burst 8x A100 initially.

Jin (eng-infra): Note: Azure has limited H100 availability in some regions — check quota before committing. For GCP we should request both GPU quota and TPU quota only if they plan to use TPUs.

Leo Ops: Quick checklist I suggest:
- Org/account creation + billing account linked
- Tagging policy enforced (team:, project:, cost-center:)
- IAM: infra-admin, infra-reader, sku-approver roles
- VPC subnet IP ranges reserved
- Default firewall rules + egress limits
- SSH bastion & jump policy
- Quota tickets for GPU + local SSD + ENI/EIP as needed

tara SRE: Add: request service quota for ENI per AZ, and increase connection tracking if they'll run lots of pods. Also check load balancer L4/L7 quotas.

Samir: Drafting support ticket text for AWS: 

```
Subject: Request for GPU quota increase (p4d/p4dn/A100) for account 123456789012 in us-west-2
Body: We are provisioning production inference fleet for Redwood customer workload. Please increase the following quotas in us-west-2: Elastic GPU (p4d.24xlarge) desired: 8 instances, A100 (p4d/p4de) count: 8, ENI limit per AZ: +200, EBS throughput optimized. Requesting expedited review. Ticket owner: Samir <samir@redwood.ai>
```

Jin (eng-infra): For GCP ticket: mention project numbers and link to billing account. Use this template: 

```
Project: projects/987654321
Billing account: BILL-ABC-123
Quota: GPUs (A100) -> increase from 0 to 8 in region europe-west1, GPUs (A100) -> increase to 4 in asia-southeast1
Network: Increase external IP quota by 50, Increase forwarding rules by 10
```

Maya R: Good. Also include tagging and billing contacts so support can expedite. Add expected monthly spend estimate — I put a conservative $35k/mo for the initial fleet in us-west-2.

Leo Ops: FYI — if they want lower cost, we can advise mixed instance types + quantized models. But don't promise until prod perf tests.

quota-bot: Automated note: Existing AP accounts show soft limits: A100: 0 in ap-southeast-1, H100: 0 in eu-west-1. Recommend raising at least to 2 to avoid rollout blockers.

tara SRE: Also watch networking egress caps. Some customers hit cloud provider egress rate limits when massively parallelizing small requests. Plan for NAT gateway bandwidth and per-AZ egress.

Samir: Filing AWS ticket now. Raising severity to 'high' due to timeline. Ticket #AWS-789210 created: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=AWS-789210

Maya R: Thanks. Can you paste the ticket body here and add the cost center / PO?

Samir: Pasted above and added cost center: CC-ACME-42, PO: PO-2026-009. ETA from AWS support usually 24-72hrs but we'll ping for expedited.

Jin (eng-infra): Parallel actions: create IAM groups/roles skeleton and apply tagging enforcement via org policy. I'll push the terraform templates to repo infra/provisioning/acme-ml.

Leo Ops: I'll pre-create VPC/subnet CIDR allocations and reserve EIPs in us-west-2 to avoid IP exhaustion. Also queue a request to increase EIP quota by 30.

Maya R: Can someone run a quick region availability check for p4d and h100 images? We had one account where eu-west-1 showed p4d unavailable.

tara SRE: I ran a quick check earlier: p4d available in us-west-2 and eu-central-1, limited in eu-west-1. H100 early access in limited AZs in us-west-2 — need capacity reservations if they require guaranteed nodes.

Samir: Noted — asking AWS to confirm capacity options and if dedicated hosts/reservations required.

quota-bot: Reminder: For expedited quota changes, include sample traffic pattern and expected sustained vCPU & memory usage.

Maya R: Action items:
- Samir: AWS/GCP quota tickets + paste IDs here (in progress)
- Jin: Terraform + IAM skeleton (ETA EOD)
- Leo: VPC, EIP reserve, ENI planning (ETA tomorrow morning)
- tara SRE: Networking egress checklist + NAT sizing (ETA tomorrow)

Samir: AWS ticket #AWS-789210 (created). GCP ticket created: https://cloudsupport.google.com/cases/GC-555123. Keeping both on high priority, pinging account reps.

Maya R: Cool. If tickets stall after 48hrs we escalate to our partner manager. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Leo Ops: I'll add the checklist to the onboarding doc: https://redwood.share/acct-onboard/acme-ml (will push a diff). :eyes:

Jin (eng-infra): Pushing terraform now. Will @mention when PR is ready.

Samir: Leaving a short note for follow-up: cost estimate + tagging rules must be finalized before we accept reserved capacity.

Maya R: Perfect. Closing loop later today.

quota-bot: Thread summary saved to /playbooks/cross-cloud-onboard/2111111111-summary.txt
